experimental_procedure: Representative Sulfamide Synthesis: N-(2-Allyl-phenyl)-N'-benzyl-sulfamide (1a).2 A solution of o-Allylaniline (3.00 g, 22.5 mmol) and triethylamine (4.56 g, 5.98 mL, 45.08 mmol) in dry benzene (100 mL) was cooled to 0 °C and treated with a 0.1 M solution of benzylsulfonylchloride1 in benzene (7.73 g, 37.6 mmol). After warming to room temperature, the mixture was allowed to stir for 24 h and the solvent was removed in vacuo. Chromatograpy of the crude oil on SiO2 (10-30% Et2O/hexanes gradient) provided 6.14 g, 90% of sulfamide 1a as a yellow/brown solid.
